title: Langfuse: Effect is a TypeScript framework that consists of several packages that work together to help build…
description: CVE-2026-121707 is a high-severity vulnerability affecting multiple packages of the Effect TypeScript framework, which is used to build TypeScript applications. The affected versions are prior to 4.82.0-r0, 4.82.0-r2, and 4.83.0-r0. A fix is available in these versions. No known exploits are reported in the wild.
